LICENSE_REFUSED.cause: {{b:modelBridge could not confirm an active subscription on this installation, so the request was stopped before it reached fal.ai or Anthropic.}} This is your modelBridge subscription — not your fal.ai or Anthropic key, which are unaffected. It happens when the subscription has lapsed, been paused or been revoked, or when modelBridge has gone too long without being able to re-check it. Nothing was sent to a provider and nothing was charged.
steps: Open Settings → Subscription and read the card — it names the state and what changes it
If your subscription is active, try again in a moment — modelBridge re-checks your subscription as soon as a request is refused

If it has lapsed, subscribe again from that card — a new subscription comes with a new license key by email; paste it there. If a payment failed instead, update your payment method in the Lemon Squeezy customer portal — the same key works again once modelBridge has re-checked the subscription

If you have paid and still see this, send a bug report from Settings → Plugin Feature & Bug Report — it carries the reason word (for example status:expired) that support needs. Questions about a charge, a card or a refund go to Lemon Squeezy, who handle billing as Merchant of Record

LICENSE_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE.cause: {{b:modelBridge could not run its subscription check at all, so the request was stopped as a precaution.}} This is not a verdict on your subscription: the checker itself failed to load or threw (its reason word is verification_unavailable, core_unavailable or gate_error). Requests are stopped before any provider is contacted, so nothing was sent and nothing was charged.
steps: Quit and reopen Premiere Pro — this reloads the background service and its checker
If it keeps happening, send a bug report from Settings → Plugin Feature & Bug Report — the reason word in the message tells support which part failed
Your subscription and your API keys need no action

MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH.cause: {{b:The file you attached is not one of the formats this model accepts.}} Every model declares its own input type — an image model will not take a video clip, and vice versa. This is caught before anything is uploaded, so no generation was started and nothing was charged.
steps: Check the formats named in the message — those are what this model accepts
To turn a video frame into an image, use the camera button (Capture frame) below the card
To convert a clip, use File > Export > Media in Premiere Pro
Or pick a different model that accepts the file you have

DUAL_MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH.cause: Dual Mode shares one selected clip between both models. Each model is validated against its own requirements — a clip that satisfies the first model can still be the wrong media type for the second. This is caught before anything is uploaded, so no generation was started and nothing was charged.
steps: Select a different clip on the timeline or in your project bin that matches what the second model needs
Or paste a URL into the first model’s own media field — this replaces the shared clip for both models, not just the second one
Or choose a different secondary model that accepts the media type your current clip provides

LOCAL_SERVER_DOWN.cause: The local helper server that modelBridge uses to communicate with Premiere Pro is not running or cannot be reached.
steps: Close and reopen Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, restart your computer
Check that a firewall or antivirus is not blocking modelBridge’s background helper

NET_ERROR.cause: modelBridge could not reach fal.ai. This is usually a temporary network issue. Your settings are preserved.
steps: Check your internet connection
Try again in a moment
If you are on a VPN or corporate network, check that fal.ai is not blocked

IMPORT_TIMEOUT.cause: The generated file was downloaded but Premiere Pro took too long to import it into the project.
steps: Try importing the file manually from the downloads folder
Check that Premiere Pro is not busy with another operation
Restart Premiere Pro if the issue persists

IMPORT_FAIL.cause: The generated file was downloaded but Premiere Pro could not import it. The file may be in a format Premiere does not support.
steps: Try importing the file manually from the downloads folder
Check that the file is not corrupted by opening it in another application
If the model outputs an unsupported format, try a different model

MEDIA_PERSIST_FAILED.cause: The file could not be saved to the modelBridge_Media folder next to your project file, so the import was cancelled. Importing it from the temporary location instead would make the clip go offline after a restart.
steps: Check that the folder containing your project file is writable — not read-only and not a restricted cloud-synced location like OneDrive
If your disk is full, free up space
If the project lives on a network share or read-only volume, save it to a local, writable location
Then run the import again — the result is still available in the preview

DOWNLOAD_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not download the generated file. The output link may have expired or the connection was interrupted. This does not confirm the charge status.
steps: Use Retry downloads if it is shown, or Check status, to recover the existing request without submitting a new generation
Check your connection and available disk space, or open the original request on your fal.ai dashboard
A missing result or usage entry does not prove that the original request failed or was free
Generate starts a new fal.ai request, which may be charged again

EXTRACT_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not extract the selected media from your Premiere Pro timeline for upload.
steps: Make sure a clip is selected in the timeline or project panel
Try selecting a different clip
If using a sequence, try selecting the individual clip instead

NO_SELECTION.cause: No clip or media item is currently selected in Premiere Pro.
steps: Click on a clip in the timeline or project panel
Make sure the clip is highlighted before clicking Generate

UPLOAD_FAIL.cause: The selected media could not be uploaded to fal.ai for processing. The file may be too large or the connection was interrupted.
steps: Try a smaller or shorter clip
Check your internet connection
Try again — upload failures are often temporary

ACCESS_GATED.cause: Some model creators restrict access to approved users. Your fal.ai account has not been granted access to this model yet.
steps: Visit the model page on fal.ai and request access
Check your fal.ai dashboard for pending access requests
Try a different model that does not require approval

ACCESS_SCOPE.cause: A fal.ai key can be made with limited permissions. The key saved in modelBridge is not allowed to use this model.
steps: Generate a new API key with full permissions on fal.ai
Replace the key in Settings → API keys
If you use a team key, ask your admin for a key with full access

AUTH_INVALID.cause: Your fal.ai API key is missing, expired, or was entered incorrectly.
steps: Open Settings → API keys in modelBridge.
Delete the current key and paste a fresh one from fal.ai
Click Save and try generating again

BALANCE_EMPTY.cause: Generations are billed per use. If your balance reaches zero or your account is locked, all new generations are blocked.
steps: Go to fal.ai billing and add funds
Return to modelBridge and try again
Check that your payment method is valid
If you’ve already added credits and still see this error, your account may need to be manually unlocked — contact fal.ai support
BALANCE_EMPTY._costTermAllow: describes fal.ai's own billing model, states no modelBridge dollar

RATE_LIMIT.cause: fal.ai enforces per-account request limits to protect model availability. The limit resets automatically after a short cooldown.
steps: Wait 30-60 seconds and try again
Avoid clicking Generate multiple times in quick succession

CONTENT_POLICY.cause: fal.ai runs automated content moderation on prompts and images. Filters vary by model — some are stricter than others.
steps: Review your prompt for terms that may trigger content filters
Try rephrasing your prompt
If using an image, try a different source image

TIMEOUT.cause: The generation took too long and fal.ai stopped waiting. This can happen with complex prompts or busy servers. Your settings are preserved.
steps: Try again — timeouts are often temporary
Try a shorter duration or simpler prompt
Check fal.ai status if the error persists

SERVER_ERROR.cause: fal.ai’s servers returned an error. This happens when their infrastructure is under heavy load or undergoing maintenance. Your settings are preserved. Server-side failures typically do not affect your balance.
steps: Wait a moment, then try again
If it persists, the platform may be experiencing a wider outage
Check fal.ai status if the error persists

PORT_CONFLICT.cause: Another app is already using the connection modelBridge needs for its background helper.
steps: Quit other apps that might be using it, or restart Premiere Pro
Restart Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, restart your computer to free the port

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.cause: Models on fal.ai can be removed, renamed, or replaced without notice. The address this model was installed from no longer exists.
steps: Search for the model by name. It may have a new address
Remove the model from your list and add the updated version
Check the fal.ai model page for migration guidance

MIGRATION_FAILED.cause: An automatic internal update to your installed models could not be completed. Your models are safe — no data was lost.
steps: Close and reopen the modelBridge panel to retry
If this keeps happening, check that your disk has free space
If it keeps happening, send a report from Settings → Plugin Feature & Bug Report

SCHEMA_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not load this model's settings from fal.ai. They may be temporarily unavailable.
steps: Try again in a moment
Remove and re-add the model
If the issue persists, the model may not be compatible with modelBridge

LICENSE_INVALID.cause: Your modelBridge subscription could not be verified. The license may have expired, or the license server is temporarily unreachable.
steps: Open Settings → Subscription — the card names the state and what changes it
If you bought a new subscription, paste the new license key from its email there — buying again comes with a new key
If the license service was unreachable, check your internet connection — license verification requires a brief server check

LICENSE_DEVICE_LIMIT.cause: Your modelBridge license is already active on two computers — the most your plan allows.
steps: On the computer you no longer use, open Settings → Activations → Devices and release it
Or release it in your Lemon Squeezy customer portal at app.lemonsqueezy.com/my-orders
Then activate again on this computer

EXT_NOT_LOADED.cause: The modelBridge extension did not initialize completely. This usually happens after a Premiere Pro update or if the extension files were modified.
steps: Close and reopen Premiere Pro
If the issue persists, reinstall modelBridge from the installer
Check that unsigned extensions are enabled (PlayerDebugMode)

QUEUE_FAIL.cause: modelBridge could not submit the generation request to fal.ai. The request may have been rejected before entering the queue.
steps: Check your internet connection
Try again in a moment
If the issue persists, check fal.ai status for service disruptions

RESULT_NO_MEDIA_URL.cause: fal.ai completed the generation but the response did not contain a downloadable media file. The model may have answered with text or numbers instead of a picture, video or sound.
steps: Try generating again — this is sometimes a transient issue
Try a different model
Check fal.ai/dashboard for the raw result

VALIDATION_DURATION.cause: Video inpainting models require a mask video clip, not a still image. The mask was either a single frame or shorter than the model’s minimum duration.
steps: Use the Draw Mask tool — it automatically creates a video mask at the correct duration
If using a URL, make sure it points to a video file, not an image
Trim your mask clip to meet the model’s minimum duration, then try again

VALIDATION_TYPE.cause: One or more settings required by this model are missing or have an invalid value. Each model defines its own parameter requirements.
steps: Review the settings above the Generate button
Look for fields highlighted in red
If a required field is empty, enter a value and try again

FACE_NOT_DETECTED.cause: This model requires a clear, visible face in the input image. The AI could not detect a face in the image you provided.
steps: Use a photo where the face is well-lit and clearly visible
Ensure the face is not obscured by hair, accessories, or motion blur
Try a different photo with the subject facing the camera

IMAGE_LOAD_ERROR.cause: fal.ai could not process your image. The file may be corrupted, partially downloaded, or in an unsupported format.
steps: Re-export the image from Premiere Pro (File > Export Frame)
Try converting to JPG or PNG format
If using a URL, ensure the link is publicly accessible and points directly to an image file

AUDIO_DURATION_LONG.cause: The audio clip exceeds the maximum duration this model can process.
steps: Trim the audio to a shorter duration
Trim your audio clip to fit within the model's maximum duration, then try again
Try splitting long audio into shorter segments

AUDIO_DURATION_SHORT.cause: The audio clip is shorter than the minimum duration this model requires.
steps: Use a longer audio clip
For voice cloning models, use at least 3-5 seconds of clear speech
Use a longer audio clip that meets the model's minimum duration, then try again

DOWNSTREAM_ERROR.cause: A third-party service that this model depends on returned an error. This is not caused by your input. Your settings are preserved.
steps: Try again in a few minutes
If the issue persists, the model's external dependency may be experiencing an outage
Check fal.ai status if the error persists

GPU_MEMORY_EXCEEDED.cause: The model ran out of GPU memory during generation. This is a server-side resource issue on fal.ai, not caused by your input.
steps: Try again — GPU allocation varies between attempts
Try a lower resolution or shorter duration
If the issue persists, try a different model

INVALID_LORA_URL.cause: The model tried to load a LoRA (fine-tuning) weight file from a URL that could not be resolved. This can happen if the LoRA was removed or the URL is incorrect.
steps: If you provided a LoRA URL, check that it is correct and publicly accessible
Try removing the LoRA URL and generating without it
If the model applies a built-in LoRA, this is a model-side issue — try a different model

SPEAKER_NOT_FOUND.cause: The model requires a valid speaker ID for voice synthesis, but the provided ID was not recognized.
steps: If the model has a speaker dropdown, select a different voice
Leave the speaker field empty to use the model's default voice
Check the model's documentation on fal.ai for available speaker IDs

PREMIERE_TIMEOUT_UNCONFIRMED.cause: Premiere Pro stopped responding, so modelBridge stopped waiting — but the change may already have been applied. Doing it again could apply it twice.
steps: Check your timeline or project to see whether the change is already there
If it is not, ask again in the chat
If Premiere is still unresponsive, look for an open dialog box, then restart it

PREMIERE_TIMEOUT.cause: {{b:Premiere Pro stopped answering while modelBridge was waiting on it, so the operation was cancelled rather than left hanging.}} The usual reason is a dialog box open somewhere in Premiere — an unsaved-changes prompt, a missing-media warning, a codec message — which blocks scripting until someone clicks it. A very large project or import can also take longer than the time allowed. Check whether the operation already completed before retrying. An existing generation may already have incurred a charge; this local timeout does not establish its cost.
steps: Look at Premiere Pro for an open dialog box and dismiss it — check other monitors, it can open behind the panel
Try the same request again — this usually succeeds once Premiere is free
If it was a large project open, save, or import, give it a moment and retry
If Premiere stays unresponsive, restart it and reopen the modelBridge panel

PREMIERE_RESULT_UNCONFIRMED.cause: Premiere returned an answer that modelBridge could not read. The operation may already have changed the project or written a file; the unreadable reply proves neither success nor failure.
steps: Inspect the affected timeline, project item or output file before doing anything again
Repeat the operation only after confirming that the requested change was not applied
If the outcome remains unclear, do not repeat the operation; send a report from Settings

EXTENDSCRIPT.cause: A Premiere Pro scripting operation failed. This can happen when Premiere Pro is busy, no sequence is open, or the timeline state is unexpected.
steps: Make sure a sequence is open and active in the timeline
Restart the modelBridge extension panel (Window > Extensions > modelBridge)
If the issue persists, restart Premiere Pro

SERVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT.cause: The model took too long to load into GPU memory. This happens when a model hasn’t been used recently and needs a "cold start."
steps: Try again immediately — the model is likely still loading from your first attempt
If it fails again, wait 1-2 minutes and retry
Try a more popular variant of the same model family

CONTENT_POLICY_NO_MEDIA.cause: The provider returned no usable output. Without an explicit reason, this does not establish moderation, a particular input problem or charge status.
steps: Try a more specific, descriptive prompt
Use a source image with more detail and contrast
Use settings supported by this model; check the existing request before generating again
Try a different model

GENERATION_NOT_FOUND.cause: {{b:The generation you were waiting for can no longer be found on fal.ai.}} The request record may have expired. This response alone does not show whether the request completed or was charged.
steps: Open your fal.ai dashboard and check your recent requests — if the run finished, the result can be downloaded from there
A missing dashboard record or usage entry does not prove the request failed or was free
Generate starts a new fal.ai request, which may be charged again
Your cost history in modelBridge shows whether fal.ai reported any usage for this run

RUNNER_FAILURE.cause: {{b:The fal.ai machine assigned to this generation crashed, or fal.ai could not get one at all.}} This happens on fal.ai’s side — usually when a model is at capacity — and it is not caused by your input or by modelBridge. The run did not finish.
steps: Try again — a fresh run gets a new server
If it keeps happening, the model may be at capacity right now — wait a few minutes or try a different model
Check fal.ai’s status page if several models are affected

RESULT_FETCH_FAILED.cause: modelBridge could not retrieve the result response for an existing fal.ai request. Its completion and charge status may still be unconfirmed.
steps: Use Check status to check the existing request; it does not submit a new generation
If Retry downloads is shown, use it to retrieve the missing files from that request
Check the original request on your fal.ai dashboard; a missing dashboard or usage record does not prove it failed or was free
Generate starts a new fal.ai request, which may be charged again

LICENSE_SEAT_TAKEN.cause: {{b:Another of your computers started generating, so this request was stopped before it reached fal.ai or Anthropic.}} Your plan covers two computers, and one generates at a time: the computer you start working on takes over, and the other one is told the next time it tries. Nothing is wrong with your subscription, nothing was sent to a provider and nothing was charged.
steps: Press Generate (or send your message) again on this computer — that makes it the active one
The other computer will see this same notice the next time it tries, and its next press takes the license back
If you do not recognise the computer named in the message, free it up in your Lemon Squeezy customer portal, then paste your license key once under Settings → Subscription

LICENSE_RELEASED.cause: {{b:This computer’s activation was released, so the request was stopped before it reached fal.ai or Anthropic.}} An activation is released from your Lemon Squeezy account, from the Devices card on another computer, or by modelBridge support. Your subscription itself is unaffected; nothing was sent to a provider and nothing was charged.
steps: Open Settings → Subscription and paste your license key — it is in your Lemon Squeezy receipt email
Re-entering the key on a computer that was released reuses its slot; it does not use up another one

If activation answers that the license is already active on two computers, release one you no longer use first — in Settings → Activations → Devices on that computer, or in your Lemon Squeezy customer portal

IMPORT_FAILED.cause: The generated file was downloaded but Premiere Pro could not import it. The file may be in a format Premiere does not support.
steps: Try importing the file manually from the downloads folder
Check that the file is not corrupted by opening it in another application
If the model outputs an unsupported format, try a different model

VALIDATION_ONE_OF.cause: The selected value is not one of the options supported by this model.
steps: Choose one of the supported options shown in the error.
